title: Over the PCIe link · ET-SoC-1
description: The host link of the ET-SoC-1, timed through the runtime on three cards: copy bandwidth from 4 KB to 256 MB against the Gen4 x8 figure, staged and DMA-only, small-copy latency and the runtime's polling behind it, empty-kernel launch latency, and what several transfers at once do (two host-to-card commands of one stream halve the rate, one on each of two streams does not) and where a host copy lands (the L3); every value with its 99% interval over five runs, against predictions stated before the runs.
